title: 选择疑问句（or 连接，如Do you like coffee or tea?）
knowledgePoint: 选择疑问句的核心结构（一般疑问句+or+选项/特殊疑问句+or+选项）、语序规则、回答方式（直接选择不用yes/no）、or连接并列选项的语法一致性、与一般疑问句的区别

questions.question: — ______ you prefer to work from home ______ go to the office tomorrow? — I prefer working from home to avoid the traffic jam.
questions.explanation: 谓语动词prefer是实义动词，一般疑问句需用助动词Do；选择疑问句用or连接两个并列选项，and用于肯定句表并列，不符合语境。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 实义动词作谓语时，选择疑问句的结构为“Do/Does/Did+主语+动词原形+选项A+or+选项B？”。

questions.question: Is the meeting going to be held on Monday or on Tuesday? The manager hasn’t confirmed the exact date yet.
questions.explanation: 句子为be动词引导的选择疑问句，or连接两个并列的时间状语（on Monday/on Tuesday），语序正确，语义逻辑通顺。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 选择疑问句中，or连接的选项需保持语法结构一致（如均为介词短语、名词短语等）。

questions.question: — ______ is more suitable for the project—Mr. Li ______ Ms. Wang? — Ms. Wang, because she has more relevant experience.
questions.explanation: 疑问词询问“人”且作主语，用Who；选择疑问句用or连接两个并列的人名选项，Whom作宾语，不符合此处主语位置需求。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 特殊疑问句型的选择疑问句结构为“疑问词+一般疑问句+选项A+or+选项B？”。

questions.question: Did they decide to take the train, the plane, or by bus? They need to arrive at the destination before Friday.
questions.explanation: or连接的选项语法结构不一致：the train/the plane是名词短语，by bus是介词短语，需统一为名词短语（the train, the plane, or the bus）或介词短语（by train, by plane, or by bus）。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 选择疑问句中，or连接的多个选项需保持语法形式一致，避免结构混杂导致歧义。

questions.question: — ______ the new policy will benefit small businesses ______ large corporations more? — It will benefit both equally, according to the official statement.
questions.explanation: 句子为主语从句结构（the new policy will benefit...），选择疑问句需将助动词Will提前；or连接两个并列宾语（small businesses/large corporations），符合选择逻辑。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 含从句的选择疑问句，需将主句的助动词/情态动词提前，保持主句语序正确。

questions.question: Would you like to have dinner at home or go to a restaurant? I can cook your favorite dishes if you choose to stay.
questions.explanation: 句子为委婉请求型选择疑问句，Would you like to...后接两个并列的不定式结构（have dinner/go to a restaurant），or连接符合规则，语义连贯。
questions.knowledgeExtension: Would you like to...引导的选择疑问句，or连接的选项需为并列的不定式短语（to do sth.）。

questions.question: — ______ language do you want to learn next—Spanish ______ Portuguese? — Spanish, because it’s more widely used in international business.
questions.explanation: 疑问词询问“在特定范围内选择哪一个”，用Which；选择疑问句用or连接两个并列的语言名称选项，What无“限定范围选择”的含义。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 选择范围明确时用Which，范围不明确时用What（如What language do you speak?）。

questions.question: Has she finished reading the novel or the article? She told me she would finish one of them today.
questions.explanation: 句子为现在完成时的选择疑问句，助动词Has提前，or连接两个并列的名词宾语（the novel/the article），语序正确，与后文“one of them”逻辑一致。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 完成时态的选择疑问句结构为“Have/Has/Had+主语+过去分词+选项A+or+选项B？”。

questions.question: — ______ will the conference start—at 9 a.m. ______ at 10 a.m.? — At 9 a.m., so we need to arrive 15 minutes earlier.
questions.explanation: 疑问词询问“具体时间点”，用What time更精准；选择疑问句用or连接两个并列的时间点选项，When侧重“时间段”，不符合此处语境。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 询问具体时间点用What time/When，选择疑问句中需连接两个明确的时间选项。

questions.question: Do you want to buy the red dress, the blue one, or green? I think the red one suits you best.
questions.explanation: or连接的选项语法结构不一致：the red dress/the blue one是名词短语（含限定词），green是形容词，需补充为the green one保持一致。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 选择疑问句中，并列选项需保持词性、结构一致，避免因省略导致语法残缺。

questions.question: — ______ the team use traditional methods ______ adopt new technology to solve the problem? — They will adopt new technology for higher efficiency.
questions.explanation: 主语the team为第三人称，一般将来时选择疑问句用Will引导；or连接两个并列的谓语动词短语（use traditional methods/adopt new technology），Shall仅用于第一人称。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 第一人称（I/we）的将来时选择疑问句可用Shall，第三人称用Will。

questions.question: Is this book about history, literature, or science fiction? I’m looking for a science fiction book to read in my spare time.
questions.explanation: 句子为be动词引导的选择疑问句，or连接三个并列的名词短语（history/literature/science fiction），结构一致，语义与后文需求匹配。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 选择疑问句可连接两个及以上选项，or放在最后一个选项前，其余选项用逗号分隔。

questions.question: — ______ did you receive the invitation—by email ______ by phone? — By email, it was sent last Monday.
questions.explanation: 疑问词询问“方式”，用How；选择疑问句用or连接两个并列的方式状语（by email/by phone），What询问“内容”，不符合语境。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 询问方式、方法的选择疑问句，用How引导，or连接并列的方式选项。

questions.question: Did he go to the supermarket to buy food, drinks, or to buy snacks? He needs to prepare for the party tonight.
questions.explanation: or连接的选项语法结构不一致：buy food/drinks是不定式短语省略to（与前文to buy并列），to buy snacks重复to，需改为buy snacks保持一致。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 并列不定式短语作目的状语时，or连接的后续选项可省略to，保持结构简洁一致。

questions.question: — ______ is the better choice for the team leader—someone with experience ______ someone with enthusiasm? — Someone with both, I think.
questions.explanation: 疑问词询问“两个选项中哪一个”，用Which；or连接两个并列的名词短语（someone with experience/someone with enthusiasm），Who询问“具体的人”，不符合此处“选择类型”的语境。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 选择疑问句中，询问“哪一个选项更优”时用Which，询问“具体的人”用Who。

questions.question: Can you speak English fluently or French? I need someone who can communicate with foreign clients.
questions.explanation: or连接的选项语法结构不一致：speak English fluently是“动词+宾语+副词”，French是名词，需补充为speak French fluently保持一致。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 选择疑问句中，并列的谓语短语需保持结构完整，避免因省略导致语义不清晰。

questions.question: — ______ will the project be completed—in three months ______ in six months? — In three months, if everything goes smoothly.
questions.explanation: 疑问词询问“多久之后”，用How soon；选择疑问句用or连接两个并列的时间段选项（in three months/in six months），How long询问“动作持续时间”，不符合语境。
questions.knowledgeExtension: How soon用于询问“将来多久之后”，回答用in+时间段；How long用于询问“持续时间”，回答用for+时间段。

questions.question: Are we going to visit the museum, the art gallery, or the zoo this weekend? Everyone can vote for their favorite place.
questions.explanation: 句子为be going to结构的选择疑问句，or连接三个并列的地点名词（the museum/the art gallery/the zoo），结构一致，语义逻辑通顺。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 选择疑问句连接多个选项时，需确保所有选项属于同一类别（如均为地点、时间、事物等）。

questions.question: — ______ do you think is more important for success—hard work ______ talent? — Hard work, because talent without effort is useless.
questions.explanation: 疑问词询问“抽象事物”，用What；选择疑问句用or连接两个并列的名词（hard work/talent），Which侧重“特定范围内的选择”，此处无明确限定范围，用What更合适。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 询问抽象概念、无明确限定范围的选择时用What，有明确范围时用Which。

questions.question: Did she choose to study abroad or staying in her home country? Her parents support whatever decision she makes.
questions.explanation: or连接的选项语法结构不一致：to study abroad是不定式，staying in her home country是动名词，需统一为to study abroad or stay（不定式）或studying abroad or staying（动名词）。
questions.knowledgeExtension: 选择疑问句中，or连接的选项需保持词性一致（如均为不定式、动名词、名词等），确保语法平行。
